note: Newest first. Read by the .update command (case.js). Keep items to one line each — they are rendered inside a WhatsApp message.

releases.title: Anti-delete, presence and status switches
items: Anti-delete: deleted messages and media are now forwarded to the owner's number
Anti-delete is ON by default — .antidelete off stops it for one chat
Deleted images, video, voice notes, stickers and documents are recovered (up to 64 MB)
Auto-typing shows "typing…" on every incoming message, not only on commands
Auto-react reacts to every incoming message — .autoreact on 🔥 picks the emoji
Status switches: .autoviewstatus and .autolikestatus now share one implementation
Every switch answers to both of its names (.autolike = .autolikestatus)
